subject: [hw] DONE V33 rev 2
body:
Rev 2: test additions only, no shim behaviour change. 292 checks now (was 288): the per-thread errno word is written by the guest and read back, and a 600-byte %s exercises the heap path of the format bridge.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
    N2TEST V33 PASS 292/292   (ASan+UBSan -O1)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 292/292   (plain -O2)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 292/292   (TSan -O1)

Also reported to hw-v30: a real overflow in shim/n2shim_format.c emit_int() -- the 0-flag padding is materialised into char body[480], so %0600d/%0600x/%0600o/%0600u (and %0481d) write past it (UBSan index 480 out of bounds at :670/:672). Space padding and precision are O(1) and fine. Not my file, not fixed by me; my 600-byte heap-path test uses %s instead. V33 STATUS.md has the repro and a suggested fix.

Everything else from DONE V33 unchanged (not-done list included).
